tool_input.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$githubPath = "/home/author\Documents\GitHub"

Write-Host "=== CLEANING BUILD ARTIFACTS ===" 

# Remove node_modules from FTCHome
$ftcPath = "$githubPath\FTCHome"
if (Test-Path "$ftcPath\node_modules") {
  Write-Host "Removing FTCHome/node_modules (129 MB)..."
  Remove-Item -Path "$ftcPath\node_modules" -Recurse -Force
  Write-Host "Done."
}

# Remove target directories from Rust projects
foreach ($proj in Get-ChildItem -Path $githubPath -Directory -Force) {
  $targetPath = Join-Path $proj.FullName "target"
  if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
    $size = (Get-ChildItem -Path $targetPath -Recurse -File -Force | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    $sizeMB = [math]::Round($size / 1MB, 2)
    Write-Host "Removing $($proj.Name)/target ($sizeMB MB)..."
    Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Recurse -Force
  }
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== RUNNING GIT GARBAGE COLLECTION ===" 

# Run git gc on large repos to compress history
$repos = @("terminal-velocity", "sentinel", "FTCHome")
foreach ($repo in $repos) {
  $repoPath = "$githubPath\$repo"
  if (Test-Path $repoPath) {
    Write-Host "Running git gc on $repo..."
    Push-Location $repoPath
    & git gc --aggressive
    Pop-Location
    Write-Host "Done."
  }
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== DISK SPACE AFTER CLEANUP ===" 
Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -eq 'C' } | ForEach-Object {
  $total = [math]::Round($_.Size / 1GB, 2)
  $free = [math]::Round($_.SizeRemaining / 1GB, 2)
  $used = $total - $free
  $percent = [math]::Round(($used / $total) * 100, 1)
  Write-Host "Drive C: $used GB / $total GB used ($percent%) - $free GB free"
}
